title: BraineumDEX
tagline: Building a decentralized exchange for the Braineum Ecosystem.
description: The idea here is to continue building for the Braineum ecosystem and in this hackathon which is primarily about decentralized exchanges I decided to build such an exchange. Decentralized exchanges flatten the investment world where anyone can at anytime swap one token for another.
how_its_made: Formulating an idea for this hackathon was quite challenging. At the end I settled on building a decentralized exchange using as a base a Moralis tutorial I saw. I did read through the Uniswap documentation but even that was challenging on a first read. Moralis provided a very straight forwards interface. I will revisit the Uniswap documentation as DEXes are an important part of the Web3 ecosystem.
